description: PyBOP is a Python package for estimating and optimizing parameters of battery models. It offers deterministic and stochastic search methods, example workflows and diagnostics for the fit and optimizer convergence. It can work with electrochemical or equivalent-circuit models, including models from PyBaMM, under operating conditions supplied by the user. Spatial coverage is a modeled cell or pack, not a fixed grid site, and time span follows the experiments or simulated duty cycle. Its public repository and documentation are BSD-3-Clause. Fitted parameters can improve storage behaviour in electric-vehicle or grid-battery simulations and support design comparisons. A caveat is that identifiability and measurement error may yield multiple plausible parameter sets, so prediction under new duty cycles needs separate validation. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS summary and own README were inspected without performing an optimization.
name: PyBOP battery model parameterisation
